## StrictServerInterface

Every CF-Accounts handler must implement this interface. The strict handler
wraps it so that each operation receives a fully-decoded typed request object
and must return a typed response object — no raw `http.ResponseWriter` writes
inside handlers.

    // Create a new customer account
    // (POST /v1/accounts)
    CreateAccount(ctx context.Context, request CreateAccountRequestObject) (CreateAccountResponseObject, error)

    // Suspend or delete an account

    // Get account by ID

    // List credential metadata
    // (GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/credentials)
    ListCredentials(ctx context.Context, request ListCredentialsRequestObject) (ListCredentialsResponseObject, error)

    // Create an API key pair
    // (POST /v1/accounts/{accountId}/credentials)

    // Revoke an API key

## Wiring

The strict handler bridges `StrictServerInterface` to the stdlib `net/http`
`ServerInterface`. To wire it in `main.go`:

```go
handler := generated.NewStrictHandler(myHandlerImpl, nil)
mux := http.NewServeMux()
generated.HandlerFromMux(handler, mux)
```

The `StrictHandlerFunc` / `StrictMiddlewareFunc` types allow per-operation
middleware (e.g. authentication checks) to be injected at the strict layer
before the handler is invoked.
